newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet prices steady, diffs offset NYMEX drop.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet prices steady, diffs offset NYMEX drop.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices ended near unchanged Thursday, with the weakness in the NYMEX prices offset by the stronger differentials.
U.S. Gulf 54-grade prompt barrels were sought by buyers between 1.50 and 1.25 cents under the screen, up about 0.5 cents on the day, with very little activity seen.
"I just haven't seen any offers," one jet broker said. "I think people would easily pay 1.25 cents (under NYMEX) for it," he added.
Traders said BP and Koch were both active buyers Wednesday and early Thursday, helping boost prices.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
